desc: The Girls With Guns Midnight Shotgun Case features a lockable gun case with durable lining to help protect your investment in a minimalistic design. Fitted for 52-inches long shotguns, this case provides a flap pocket for your accessories while a hanging loop keeps your case clean and off the ground when not in use. Exclusive new camo pattern designed by women for women GWG Shade Blackout Camo will certainly turns heads your next outing.
